description: Test file for the 'imaging' package, testing image decoding functionalities including decoder creation, decoding images, handling unsupported formats, and memory-bounded decoding with concurrency control.

methods.name: TestNewDecoder
methods.description: Tests creation of a new decoder with various options, checking for proper handling of invalid, empty, and valid configurations.

methods.name: TestDecoderDecode
methods.description: Tests decoding of PNG images with default options and concurrency control, verifying image and format correctness.

methods.name: TestPSDNotSupported
methods.description: Verifies that decoding a PSD header results in an 'unknown format' error, indicating PSD support was removed.

methods.name: TestDecoderDecodeMemBounded
methods.description: Tests memory-bounded decoding with concurrency, error handling, and multiple release calls, ensuring proper resource management and error propagation.
